I Thought It Was Clothing, But It’s Clay! The Knitted Mug That Fools 99%

This is the process of making a knitted mug that looks like clothing, but is actually made from clay.
At first glance, it looks like a soft knitted fabric wrapped around a cup, but this mug is a ceramic piece made through kneading, drying, glazing, and firing.
The clay is carefully prepared to prevent cracking, the knit texture is protected during the process, and the mug is completed after the first and second firings.
Please enjoy the special knitted ceramic mug-making process by Goyu Pottery.
